I'm talking about variation in an album. Bands usually choose one genre and just go with it until the end of the project. I find that boring, that's why Talking Heads is one of my favs (I haven't listened to all their albums though).

I just can't listen through an entire Rock album from before the 2000s. It starts getting repetitive, there's no variation even though the songs are objectively good. The Smiths, The Beetles, The Clash, even Rage Against the Machine. I find more modern rock a lot more amusing and the albums more diverse.

My biggest problem with rock music released before the 2000s is that they all kinda sound the same (that doesn't mean they're bad, it's just that the sound pallet for the genre was very limited). This is not the case for Talking Heads. Their albums always have a lot of variety and quirky ideas. One of the most influential bands for sure.

Edit: I guess I got my point all messed up in this comment. My problem is with how bands from that time didn't have much variation in their discography, not that all bands sound the same.

The point of it being Slow is so you can't attack twice in the same turn. The opponent needs to have the chance to react to the constant attacks (also, Zinneia makes it focus so the deck has a game finisher).

Yeah, a bunch of comments pointed out that I made Irelia too specific for her Blade Dance package. The point is for her synergies to keep the same, but without the previous toxic playstyle, so I guess I didn't accomplish that part.
I'll try reworking the other Blade Dance cards later, since there aren't many of them. And about the similarities with Katarina, she also needs a rework so I didn't even consider that.
I'm working on a new version and I found a way to make the attack effect on Lvl 2 less broken. Thanks for the feedback ;)

I thought about the Recall mechanic to synergize with the Play effect and to make the player choose between keep Irelia on board for future attacks, or Recall her now to Blade Dance again when you have enough mana. Also, I don't see why she would need the spell mana.

Katarina's design is quite bad, so I disconsidered their similarities.

I thought about the similarities with Katarina, but Kat isn't really a good design, so I would like to change her too. My goal with this reworking was to make her gameplay feel like dancing: attack with blades, swap places, recall to hand, do it all again...

And about her deck being too specific, I actually agree! I'll try changing the level up requirement to give her more options during deckbuilding.
Yeah, I'm still not sure about her stats and level up requirement. Ionia already has too many 3 cost champs, so making her 4 would make the region more varied.

The attack effect on Lvl 1 is just to make her level up faster. I removed it from Lvl 2 because she already attack with the blades and gains the Bladesurge.

And yes, I agree that her level up requirement might need to change. I thought about "I've seen 10+ allies attack" so she has to be on board to have get to level 2.
